## Context checklist (AGENTS.md §6–7)
- [ ] `wms-docs/STATE.md` updated (Done / In progress / Log entry)
- [ ] Spec in `wms-docs/specs/` created or updated
- [ ] ADR added for any decision (`wms-docs/_meta/decisions/`)
- [ ] `VERSION` bumped, or parallel-run DevOps-at-merge exception explained
- [ ] Tests pass, incl. cross-tenant test for new endpoints
- [ ] RFID flow + exceptions + QR fallback (with logged reason) covered
- [ ] No secrets, no `.env` committed

- [ ] Remote changes compared and integrated; conflict decisions preserved in committed context
- [ ] Paired-agent cross-review: reviewer, final candidate SHA, verdict and checks recorded (or unpaired applicability explained)
